nodes.label: Compositor (e.g. picom)
nodes.rationale: With a compositor the card shadow appears; without one flamenote cuts the corners with a mask so no black square is left behind.

nodes.label: Global hotkey
nodes.rationale: Default Super+Shift+N; Esc cannot be the hotkey because Esc already returns the cursor during selection and closes the toolbox.

nodes.label: Single-instance lock
nodes.rationale: A second run arms the selection instead of creating another process; if the lock is busy and the request does not reach the main process it prints 'flamenote já está em execução.' and exits.

nodes.label: Note card (bilhete)
nodes.rationale: White rounded note always above other windows; a movement under about 3 pixels does not count as a drag so that double click keeps closing it.

nodes.label: X11 PRIMARY selection
nodes.rationale: The tool only accepts PRIMARY selections owned by the focused window, a parent in the window tree, another client of the same process (_NET_WM_PID) or the same X11 connection, which catches the invisible window where GTK and Chromium keep the selection.

nodes.label: Selection arming mode (crosshair)
nodes.rationale: The system cursor disappears and a crosshair follows the pointer; the crosshair does not receive clicks so dragging still works in the window underneath, and the toolbox does not open at this moment.

nodes.label: Systray (XEmbed protocol)
nodes.rationale: Uses the classic systray protocol, the same one used by i3bar with tray_output; without a tray the hotkey still works and the program warns once.

nodes.label: Toolbox
nodes.rationale: Appears next to the end of the selection, does not steal focus, and is not closed by clicking outside it; it is closed by Esc, the hotkey again, a left click on the tray, or using the tool.

nodes.label: X11
nodes.rationale: The program talks to X11 directly; it does not start under Wayland.

nodes.label: config.toml
nodes.rationale: Written with defaults on first run if missing and re-read every 2 seconds; an invalid hotkey falls back to the default with a terminal message.

nodes.label: flamenote
nodes.rationale: Floating notes created from the currently selected text, in the spirit of Flameshot.
